subject: general
question: Which State is known as the ‘land of five rivers?’
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Indian state of **Punjab**__ is known as the ‘land of five rivers'.
 
• The five rivers in Punjab are:
 
 
• Beas.
 
• Chenab.
 
• Jhelum.
 
• Ravi.
 
• Sutlej.
 
 
 
• Punjab is known as the '**granary of India**' and '**breadbasket of India**'.
 
• Punjab is the first state in India to come under the **president's rule.**
 
• The road crossing between India and Pakistan, **Wagah border** is located in Punjab.
 
• The Historic place **Jalianwalabagh** is in Punjab.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fabe2f70848484798ea0d052cea2defe98e08668106c7df067f1c8c03a3a73a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is known as the 'tiger state of India'.
 
• **Meghalaya** is known as the 'abode of clouds'.
 
• **Chattisgarh** is also known as 'Dakshina Kosala'
